One-Concern Parent Session

RM350 · 45 minutes · Online

One repeated concern. One clear next step.

What’s included

A focused exploration of one recurring concern, a working understanding of the pattern, what may be worth observing or investigating, one practical response to try, and a concise written next-step summary.

How booking and payment work

Founder confirmation required before payment. Submit a booking request. CJ reviews suitability, capacity and availability. CJ gives written permission to pay. Local clients can then make payment by bank transfer or DuitNow QR, while international clients can use Wise bank transfer using details sent privately. Send payment proof through the private channel provided. CJ verifies payment before confirming the booking. A request, payment or proof is not automatic booking confirmation.

Request this session →

APC Home Support Programme

RM1,800 · Four sessions · Once every two weeks

Turn autism advice into a practical home plan you can actually use.

Start with a free call to check fit.

What’s included

Prioritise the most important concern and build a personalised Home Support Plan. Use implementation guidance, review what happened, and adjust the plan based on your family’s experience. WhatsApp clarification throughout the active programme, followed by one check-in about a month after the final session.

Book a free First Step Call →

Paid support is subject to CJ’s suitability, capacity and availability review. International clients may be accepted for online support. Wait for individual written permission before paying. A request, payment or proof is not a confirmed booking.

Booking, payment and full support details

One-Concern Parent Session: One repeated concern. One clear next step. RM350 · 45 minutes · Online. The session includes a focused exploration of one recurring concern, a working understanding of the pattern, what may be worth observing or investigating, one practical response to try and a concise written next-step summary.

No First Step Call is required when your concern is clear. If suitability or scope is uncertain, the Free 15-Min First Step Call is available as a fit check. It is not a consultation, assessment, diagnostic service, or advice session.

APC Home Support Programme: Turn autism advice into a practical home plan you can actually use. RM1,800 · Four sessions · Once every two weeks. Together, prioritise the most important concern, build a personalised Home Support Plan, use implementation guidance, review what happened and adjust the plan based on your family’s experience. WhatsApp clarification throughout the active programme, followed by one check-in about a month after the final session.

Before payment: Submit a booking request. The Founder reviews suitability, capacity and availability. If the request can proceed, the Founder gives individual written permission to pay. After permission, local clients receive bank transfer or DuitNow QR details and international clients receive Wise bank transfer details, all sent privately. Send payment proof through the private channel provided. The Founder verifies payment before confirming the booking manually. A request, payment or proof is not automatic booking confirmation.

One step at a time.

  1. 1

    Notice

    Look at what happens before, during and after a difficult moment.

  2. 2

    Try

    Choose one manageable change that fits your family’s routine.

  3. 3

    Review

    In ongoing support, look at what happened and adjust together.
